ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70% high-intensity (yellowish-beige) to 30% low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity region centered medially; low-intensity pigmentation forms a continuous band along the trailing edge and distal tips; white high-contrast mottling is localized at the transition boundaries between the dark margins and the light center.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: U-shaped depression at approximately 110 degrees, with a bounding-box depth approximately 1/10th the vertical height of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregularities (pixel-level peaks and valleys) along the entire span, with higher amplitude serrations concentrated on the outer distal thirds of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Broad convex sweep from the median notch to the distal tips, forming a wide shallow V-shape.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Several small circular high-contrast white pixel clusters (~5-15 pixels in diameter) visible on the medial-left and lower-right regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct vertical low-intensity linear streaks on the left lobe; multiple faint horizontal disruptions on the right lobe distal tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular dark pigmentation clusters located in the lower-left medial high-intensity zone that deviate from the surrounding pixel values.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced yellowish-beige chromatic shift across all high-intensity regions compared to the pure white mottling at the edges.
